titleEn: I Want to Float It Soon

pages.text: Summer sunlight warmed the stream. Grandpa found bark in the shed, just the right size for a boat.
Nils wanted to make a boat and float it in the stream, with a sail too. "A sailboat! I want to float it soon!"
Grandpa began shaping the bottom. Beside him, Nils shuffled his feet.
"The bottom is good enough!" Nils took the boat. He barely stuck the sail in, crooked.
He floated it in the stream. The boat rocked from side to side downstream.
It fell onto its side. The wet sail drooped.
The boat caught in water plants and stopped. Nils lifted it out. The mast had come loose.
Grandpa put it on his palm, looking this way and that. He showed Nils the uneven bottom.
Together, they finished it. A flat bottom, a straight sail. This time Nils waited to the end.
They floated it again. Smoothly, it glided with the current. Nils hopped along after it.
